title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words
authors: A. Dosovitskiy, L. Beyer, A. Kolesnikov, et al. (12 authors)
before: Vision belonged to convolutional networks; transformers were for text.
problem: Two different architectures meant no shared representation between modalities.
breakthrough: Cut an image into patches, treat each as a token, and feed them to a plain Transformer encoder.
why: One architecture for pixels and words is the precondition for every multimodal model that followed.
next: CLIP, Flamingo, LLaVA and the native multimodal frontier models.
inherits: Patches as tokens, the standard way images enter an LLM.
